summary: The specific true→false correction is independently justified. doc/views.md defines battlefield creature summoning sickness; doc/casting.md describes the restriction for creatures. Pinned CR302.6 evidence in doc/evidence/casting/README.md explicitly distinguishes creature control-since-turn-start restrictions from fresh lands, which have no creature sickness. Existing views_tests.rs:226 positively asserts creature sickness. Thus a newly played noncreature Forest should expose false, independently of actual output. Retain all other assertions: both starting seats, five decisions (two keeps, two upkeep passes, land), turn 1, life 20/20, hands 6/7 by starting seat, libraries 33/33, exactly one untapped Forest, and empty other public zones. Reviewed local evidence only; no edits or execution. This approves only the expectation correction, not the final candidate.
